name: Maihama Sumito
source: Sumito, with his mother at the helm of Dream Garden, radiates a natural cheerfulness. Although academic studies don't captivate him, resulting in less-than-stellar grades, he finds solace and joy in the world of novels. This love for literature has not only made him an avid reader but also inspired him to craft his own stories in the form of web novels. Beyond the pages, Sumito has a flair for adapting to various part-time jobs, a testament to his versatile and resourceful nature, further enriching his life experiences.
